mfd/ai-filemetadata.description: Import ApplicationType from TYPO3\CMS\Core\Http (1.6.3+ imports a class that does not exist) and generate alt texts on upload only in a backend request unless generateAltTextInFrontend is on, so CLI jobs that write images to FAL (nr_repurpose) no longer call the vision model; a failed generation is logged as a warning instead of failing the upload
FalAdapter::localizeFile(): log DataHandler errors as a warning instead of DebuggerUtility::var_dump(), which wrote HTML into the AJAX upload response; the exception stays

thieleundklose/autotranslate.description: Local translator hook: route translations through a container-resolved \DeepL\Translator subclass (nr-llm bridge) instead of the DeepL client
